statement: A rubric-version constant's "adds only X" comment is hand-maintained, while the gates on that constant are code-maintained elsewhere — nothing forces them to agree, so a new gate added under an existing version silently invalidates the declaration. Cejel's WITAN_RUBRIC_VERSION_V23 comment claimed it "adds only" A1 command-flag coverage, but three v23-specific mechanisms were gated on it, including per-signal (not whole-criterion) abstention — a semantics change to what a non-finding means, the least visible of the three. An auto-derived manifest distinguishing "version-specific" from "inherited" gates was rejected as brittle: inheritance chains here split their two deciding version references across different source lines, defeating a same-line regex. Fix: corrected prose plus a test pinning the version-constant reference count in the gated file, failing loud if a gate is added without updating the declaration; verified red with a throwaway fourth marker.
